title: Reputation management
summary: A steady way to ask for reviews, reply in your voice, and deal with fakes without begging customers.
metaTitle: Review and Reputation Management | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Review requests, replies, and fake-review cleanup for Western Slope businesses. Included in the monthly local SEO plans.
body:
Reviews are part of local search, and they are also the thing a person reads in the truck before they call the next company. A pile of unread one-star posts, or a listing with no new reviews for a year, both cost you jobs.

On the monthly plans I set up a short ask that goes out after the work is done, reply to new reviews, and flag fakes. I will not buy reviews or tell customers what star to tap. That is how listings get wiped.
gets: A simple review link and a message you are willing to send
Timing that follows a finished job, not a random Tuesday blast
Replies drafted in your voice for you to approve or for me to post
A process for unfair or fake reviews
Notes in the monthly report on review velocity and themes

steps.title: Set the ask
steps.text: One link, a short message, and a moment in the job when asking is reasonable.

steps.title: Reply
steps.text: New reviews get a response. Patterns in the comments tell us what the site should say more clearly.

steps.title: Protect the listing
steps.text: Duplicates, spam reviews, and impersonation get documented and challenged.

faqs.q: Can you remove a bad review?
faqs.a: Only if it breaks Google's rules. A real customer who is unhappy usually stays up. I can help you reply and, when it is allowed, file a dispute. I will not promise a deletion.
No. I will not ask friends to pose as customers, and I will not sell review packages.

faqs.q: Is this included in the monthly plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Review strategy and management are part of both the $850 and $1,500 plans.

faqs.q: What if we barely have any reviews?
faqs.a: Then the first job is a clean ask after real jobs, not a gimmick. New reviews take weeks or months. That is normal.
